notes: The welcome page is now just the three words, centred, with the logo removed. The page that follows no longer promises full mock exams in the official format at every level: mocks exist at A1, A2 and B1, their writing and speaking sections are not scored, and the listening passages are read by the device voice, so they are described as modelled on the official ones. The name field now needs a letter in it, so a name like "." can no longer end up in your morning greeting; hyphens, apostrophes and spaces are still welcome, and a one-letter name is still a name.
